to  provide  short

empowerment and family development;
to develop skills and leadership qualities of girls;
to  conduct  and  hold  seminars,  conferences,
workshops, discussions, debates, art exhibitions and
similar  activities  for  the  purpose  of  promoting
knowledge and the arts;
to  collect,  classify,  print,  publish  and  distribute
books, journals, and magazines;
to promote, encourage, assist and foster activities
for  the  advancement  of  communal,  national  and
international  understanding,  religious  harmony,
goodwill and peace amongst the people;
to be a coaching centre for the General Cerificate of
Education (Advanced Level) Examination;
to  provide  vocational  courses  for  females  in  any
industry or trade using raw materials available in
the area; and
to do all such acts and things not inconsistent with
the provisions of any other written law as are, in the
opinion of the Council of Management, conducive
to furtherance of the above objectives.
